tests: a same-phase sibling verdict with no head that is unchanged since the merge base is history: a real pulse M3-P3 round-4 review committed at the base beside an anchored approving pair is excluded by name and both merge gates clear the review conditions, while a sibling whose head is present and unusable still reddens both

dangerousStates.find: ? `is unchanged since the merge base ${sibling.ground.mergeBase}, so it is history (DR-0054)`

consumesExternalOutput.provenance: Real output of the git commands the named test's control arm consumes, captured with git 2.43.0 against scratch repositories laid out as test/history-compat.test.ts stages them: git diff -z --no-renames --name-only base...head (the name list classifyReviewBudget reads; budget-name-list-m3-p3-resumed, fix round 2, where pulse's m3-p3-criteria-round4.yaml is committed at the base and the reviews add only the resumed pair) and git rev-parse --verify --quiet base:./<path> (the blob probe blobAt in src/checks.ts runs to decide that a head-less sibling is unchanged since the merge base; sibling-blob-at-base, exit 0 with pulse's blob id). The test stages it again and compares git's live output with the recorded stdout and exit, commit shas spelled by staging name, before trusting either gate.
